payload.text: Blocked 2026-11-13: basicly worktree merge m5-v4d refused with REBASE-MERGE-COMMIT. The lane carries merge commit 8f03025a (main merged into the lane, no conflict, no resolution), and the landing rebase would skip it. The tool has no merge-commit mode. Landing needs the lane linearized, which rewrites the never-pushed lane branch; a rebase by hand needs the owner. Proven on the merged lane: 15 criterion tests, 2034 kit and engine tests, refused-key search 205 hits in 60 of 1708 files, control matched. Main not changed. Follow-up for the refusal text filed under .43.

Decided by the orchestrator, 2026-11-13: land from new branches, with no reset, no hand rebase and no delete. Merging main into a lane is withdrawn for every lane; the landing tool brings the lane onto main. m5-v4d lands from harness/m5-v4d-2 at 5e963d94; perm-deny from harness/perm-deny-2 by cherry-pick of its 4 commits. Old branches harness/m5-v4d (8f03025a) and harness/perm-deny stay for the owner.
